title: Move shipped hard-tier auth refactor out of README.md's Roadmap section

evidence.quote: **Offline-First Architecture v2** — hard-tier auth refactor to simplify the offline-first model
The hard-tier upgrade flow (`localBorn` → `cloudBorn`) is atomic.

why: This Roadmap item's title/description is near-identical to Epic 23 ('Offline-First Architecture v2 — Hard-Tier Auth Refactor'), which V1_OUT_OF_SCOPE.md's epic table marks 'Done... just shipped 2026-04-15... canonical' and which architecture.md describes in the present tense as existing system behavior (Security Model section). README.md presents already-shipped work as a future roadmap item to an open-source visitor evaluating the project.
recommendation: Remove the hard-tier auth line from README.md's Roadmap (it is done); keep only genuinely unshipped items (iOS support, Epic 20 dashboard redesign).
acceptance_criteria: README.md's Roadmap section lists only features not yet shipped per architecture.md/linear-status.md
